query:
SELECT 
  ra.code,
  ra.name,
  re.entryType,
  COUNT(*) as qtd_lancamentos,
  SUM(CAST(re.amount AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total
FROM revenueEntries re
JOIN revenueAccounts ra ON re.revenueAccountId = ra.id
GROUP BY ra.code, ra.name, re.entryType
ORDER BY ra.code;
